purpose: Files in this directory that are machine-generated rng-seeded placeholders, NOT observed market or macro data. Excluded from every live institutional computation (Final Hardening, D-03). Consumers: knowledge.regime.composite_score.load_synthetic_exclusions.

PMI.csv.reason: ISM PMI history was never downloaded; this file was auto-generated as a replay filler and must not feed the macro regime composite.

GDP.csv.reason: BEA GDP history was never downloaded; replay filler only. Not part of the composite indicator set; listed for completeness.

notes: Companion synthetic copies exist under data/history/economic/ (PMI.csv, GDP.csv) and data/calendar/FOMC.csv; the same generator produced them.
Removing real-data files or adding real replacements requires deleting the synthetic file AND its entry here in the same change.
